mechanism_narrative: A sustained low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is consistently below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 thousand units combined with high consumer spending (RSAFS) above 700,000 million dollars signals an overheating economy, triggering Fed policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 305.0 (index) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), strong employment conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) below 700,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 700000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
